entities.summary: Julius Peter Heil was a German American immigrant, businessman, and Republican politician from Milwaukee, Wisconsin. He was the 30th governor of Wisconsin, serving from 1939 to 1943. Before his political career, he founded the Heil Company in Milwaukee.
